title: Establish Jest + RTL test suite across pages
context: The repo had no automated test coverage, so no change could be verified as non-regressive. This established the Jest + React Testing Library suite across the existing pages and brought the repo to its coverage gates. Landed via PR #6; the functions-coverage buffer was subsequently hardened because it sat at 95.03% against a 95% gate, a 0.03pt cushion.

expected: yarn test:coverage exits 0 with all four gates met repo-wide, and the functions metric carries a comfortable margin over the 95% threshold rather than a fractional one.
criteria: 258 tests across 58 suites green
Coverage gates met repo-wide: 99.66 stmts / 98.32 branch / 97.87 funcs / 99.66 lines

title: Add Playwright for UI render-and-measure
context: Visual and layout claims were being made by reading source rather than observing a real browser, which is how the fidelity gaps in the Figma gap run went unnoticed. Playwright was added so UI changes can be measured rather than reasoned about. Merged to develop via the BITE-006 PR.
scope: @playwright/test, playwright.config, a test:e2e script, a CI workflow, Jest ignore configuration for tests/, and a homepage render-and-measure spec. NON-GOALS: no broad E2E coverage of user journeys.
expected: yarn test:e2e drives a real browser and measures rendered geometry at defined viewports, so UI verification no longer depends on reading source.
criteria: @playwright/test installed and configured
test:e2e script available
CI workflow runs the suite
jest.config.ts ignores tests/ so the two runners do not collide
Homepage render-and-measure spec passing at mobile 390 and desktop 1440

title: Supabase foundation — install, clients, schema, RLS, seed
context: Nothing Supabase exists in the repo as of develop @ 7c032ee: no packages, no supabase/ directory, no migrations, no lib/supabase/. Restaurant data lives as module-level consts inside page files (stores/page.tsx:16-79 and the menu child components). This is the first item that moves G1, which currently has zero completions while nine G2 polish items queue ahead of it. Originally a one-line row bundling install, schema, RLS, seed and two page rewrites; split on 2026-07-21 into this foundation item plus vault-016 and vault-017.
scope: Install @supabase/ssr and @supabase/supabase-js via yarn. Create all four clients in lib/supabase/ (server, client, service, middleware). Run Supabase locally via the CLI in WSL2. Define stores, cuisine_tags, store_cuisines, menu_categories and menu_items as migrations. Enable RLS on every table with public-read and no-public-write. Add the indexes each filter touches. Seed with today's placeholder content verbatim. Generate lib/types/supabase.ts. NON-GOALS: nothing in app/ changes; no page imports a Supabase client. The root middleware.ts that invokes the middleware helper belongs to vault-002, not here.
expected: A developer can run supabase start, apply migrations, seed, and query the stores table from a scratch Server Component, getting back the same restaurants the UI currently fakes. All four typed clients import and type-check. Every table has an RLS policy. No route under app/ has changed.
criteria: @supabase/ssr and @supabase/supabase-js installed via yarn
supabase init committed; supabase start works locally in WSL2
Migrations create stores, cuisine_tags, store_cuisines, menu_categories, menu_items
Schema changes only via migration files, never Studio
RLS enabled on every table: public read gated on is_active, no public write
auth.uid() wrapped as (select auth.uid()) in any policy referencing it
Indexes created for rating, price_level, delivery_time_max, slug, name trigram, store_cuisines and menu_items ordering
Seed reproduces today's placeholder content verbatim including picsum image URLs
Money stored as integer cents, never floats
All four clients exist in lib/supabase/ and type-check
lib/types/supabase.ts generated and committed
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY referenced only in lib/supabase/service.ts
@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs is NOT introduced (forbidden by CLAUDE.md)
Nothing in app/ is modified
